source_titles: MemGPT: Towards LLMs as Operating Systems
weaknesses: agent may forget to write important facts

experiments: inject stale memories to test robustness

source_titles: Self-RAG: Learning to Retrieve, Generate, and Critique through Self-Reflection

source_titles: DeepSeek-V3 Technical Report
Command R: Retrieval-Augmented Generation at Production Scale
Mixtral of Experts
weaknesses: expert specialization is hard to inspect
answers.prototype:
class MLARetrievalMoEAgent(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, backbone, retriever, experts, k=2):
        self.mla = MLAAttention(backbone.d_model)
        self.router = TopKRouter(backbone.d_model, len(experts), k)
        self.experts = nn.ModuleList(experts)
        self.retriever = retriever
        self.citation_head = CitationHead(backbone.d_model)
    def forward(self, query, tokens):
        docs = self.retriever.search(query)
        x = pack(tokens, docs)
        x = self.mla(x)
        weights, ids = self.router(x)
        x = sparse_expert_dispatch(x, weights, ids, self.experts)
        logits = lm_head(x)
        cites = self.citation_head(x, docs)
        return logits, cites, {"expert_load": self.router.load(), "retrieval_docs": docs}
def eval_hook(batch, out): return metrics(out, ["qa_acc","citation_support","expert_balance","latency"])
